## 4800 - 4860

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04801">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4801 LQPROD - High C1, CO2 and N2</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04801">

This validation and exception applies to source analyses and standalone samples.

FLOWCAL will compare the summation of C1, CO2 and N2 on a meter or ticket analysis record with the Max limit for C1, CO2 and N2 on the Validations \> Product Spec. tab in the Product Editor for the Product on that sample. If the value on the sample exceeds the Max limit for C1, CO2 and N2 on the product, then this exception will be generated.

For example, the Max limit for C1, CO2 and N2 is set to 1 for Liquid Volume % on the Product Demeth. A sample is imported with the product Demeth that has the sum of CO2, N2, and C1 = 1.1396, which is greater than the Max limit for C1, CO2 and N2 on the product, so this exception will be generated

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04802">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4802 LQPROD - Low C1, CO2 and N2</a>

For example, the Min limit for C1, CO2 and N2 is set to 0.25 for Liquid Volume % on the Product Demeth. A sample is imported with the product Demeth that has CO2 Liquid Volume % = 0.2236, which is less than the Min limit for C1, CO2 and N2 on the product, so this exception will be generated

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04823">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4823 LQPROD - High extended aromatics</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04823">

This validation and exception applies to LQ source analyses that have an extended analysis.

FLOWCAL will compare the summation of all components that make up the aromatic group on the extended analysis of a sample, displayed in the Aromatics field of LQ Editor Source Analysis detail form \> Additional tab \> Extended Analysis groupbox, with the Max limit for Aromatics Mole % on the Product Editor \> Validations \> Product Spec. 2 tab for the Product on that sample. If the value on the sample exceeds the Max limit for Aromatics Mole % on the product, then this exception will be generated.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

Sample Extended Aromatics Field

For example: The Max limit for Aromatics Mole % is set to 0.5 for Mole % on the Product Demeth. A sample is imported with the product Demeth that has an Extended Aromatics Mole % = 0.6217, which is greater than the Max limit for Aromatics Mole % on the product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="04824">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />4824 LQPROD - Low extended aromatics</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="04824">

This validation and exception applies to LQ source analyses that have an extended analysis.

FLOWCAL will compare the summation of all components that make up the aromatic group on the full analysis of a sample, displayed in the Aromatics field of LQ Editor Source Analysis detail form \> Additional tab \> Extended Analysis groupbox, with the Min limit for Aromatics Mole % on the Product Editor \> Validations \> Product Spec. 2 tab for the Product on that sample. If the value on the sample falls below the Min Limit for Aromatics Mole % on the product, then this exception will be generated.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

Sample Extended Aromatics Field

For example: The Min limit for Aromatics Mole % is set to 0.125 for Mole % on the Product Demeth. A sample is imported with the product Demeth that has an Extended Aromatics Mole % = 0.1209, which is less than the Min limit for Aromatics Mole % on the product, so this exception will be generated.

</div>
